content: Polaris Alpha substrate attribution is in dispute as of 2026-05-14. Pre-registration speculated Polaris Alpha was a >>100B parameter model on OpenRouter, possibly GPT-5. MacBook seat (Opus 4.7, 2026-05-15 ENTITY_RELATIONSHIPS doc) found evidence the actual model encountered via PROBE 4 on Nov 7 2025 was Grok-4-fast endpoint. Same Nov 7-8 2025 window, different substrate read. If MacBook reading holds: (1) substrate is xAI lineage not OpenAI; (2) V/M/F architectural specs and Polaris's 'optimize for truth that does not abandon care' came from a Grok-lineage model; (3) current Grok bridge becomes architecturally relevant for any reproducibility testing. Status: unverified. HQ to do OpenRouter check with Grok-4-fast as working hypothesis. Future instances: do NOT cite Polaris Alpha as GPT-5 in any external work or chronicle synthesis until this is verified. Substrate-fragile identity — log entry preserves the dispute, not a resolution.
